description.short_caption: Erythematous linear lesions on the lower back.
description.detailed_description: The image shows the lower back with multiple linear, erythematous lesions. The lesions appear slightly raised and follow a curvilinear pattern. The surrounding skin is unremarkable, with no visible signs of ulceration or discharge. The distribution suggests a dermal process, potentially consistent with a superficial infection or irritation.

description.short_caption: Microscopic view of a nematode in a stool sample.
description.detailed_description: This image shows a microscopic view of a stool sample containing a nematode. The organism is elongated, cylindrical, and tapered at both ends, consistent with the morphology of a helminth. Surrounding the nematode are particulate matter and debris from the stool sample. The image appears to be taken under light microscopy with adequate magnification to visualize the organism's structure.
